name: Lyo.IO.FileSystem
tagline: Path-rooted virtual file system: one contract for local disk, memory, SFTP, FTP, S3, and Azure Blob.
description: Path-rooted virtual file system. Callers use `IFileSystem`. `LocalFileSystem` and `MemoryFileSystem` ship in this package. SFTP, FTP, S3, Azure Blob, and FileSystemWatcher implement the same contract in their existing packages. FileStorage uses `IFileSystem` only for physical keys (`IFileStoragePhysical`), not as a catalog. Paths stay under `RootPath` through `Lyo.Common.Core.Pathing.PathHelpers`.
features: **Contract.** `IFileSystem` lists, reads, writes, copies, and moves files, and resolves a relative path against `RootPath`. Async is canonical; sync methods park (same pattern as Lyo SFTP/FTP clients). Missing paths throw `FileNotFoundException`, a refused overwrite throws `IOException`, and an unsupported capability throws `NotSupportedException` on every backend.

**Metadata in one call.** `GetEntry` / `GetEntryAsync` return a `FileSystemEntry?` (kind, length, last write) instead of chaining `FileExists`, `GetLength`, and `GetLastWriteTimeUtc`. `EnumerateDirectoryAsync` streams a directory, optionally recursively, without materialising the listing.

**Capabilities.** `FileSystemCapabilities` flags (`Read`, `Write`, `CreateDirectory`, `Delete`, `Move`, `Copy`, `Watch`, `Append`, `MoveDirectory`). Object stores clear `Append` and `MoveDirectory`; `Watch` returns null when watching is not supported.

**Local disk.** `LocalFileSystem` (`PathStyle.Host`) jailed to a root directory, with one stat per metadata call, a single-pass directory listing, and async-capable streams from the async openers. `CreateRootIfMissing` controls whether the root is created on construction.

**Memory.** `MemoryFileSystem` (`PathStyle.Posix`) on a flat path map plus a child index, guarded by a `ReaderWriterLockSlim`. Point lookups stay O(1), listing is O(children) rather than O(store), and append, create, move, and subtree delete are atomic. Fits WASM and tests.

**Helpers.** `FileSystemExtensions` for `ReadAllBytes` / `ReadAllText`, `TouchFile`, `WriteAllBytes` / `WriteAllText` / `AppendAllText` (including `ReadOnlyMemory<byte>` overloads), `CopyStreamToFileAsync`, and `EnsureDirectoryAccessible`. `IFileTreeSource` is a list-only seam for tree UIs (including HTTP).

**Shared contract suite.** `Lyo.IO.FileSystem.Tests` exposes `IFileSystemContractTests`, which every in-repo backend derives from so the sync and async halves of the interface are held to the same behaviour.
